review.reason: The change introduces a configurable `data_selector` and an `OffsetPaginator` wrapper for parent campaign requests, alongside retaining the child `SinglePagePaginator`. This supports warehouse ingestion of campaign fanouts, accommodating both bare-array and wrapped responses, while preserving warehouse page-size handling.
